entries.0106065458e8c520: Businesses in the cosmetics and beauty industries
entries.08b337cb020a544e: Cosmetics containing the cosmetic raw material "Neosilk®-Human-Type Collagen I"
entries.14dc16780b1e97e6: This business develops and sells cosmetics containing the cosmetic raw material "Neosilk®-Human-Type Collagen I." It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Neosilk Cosmetics Co., Ltd., which sells mainly through domestic mail order. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2 million.
entries.173fe1d5cff6f9fb: This business provides antibody-based reagents and testing services, and produces proteins using genetically modified silkworms. It consists of three parts: diagnostic reagent services, testing services and TG silkworm services. Its main facilities are the head office (Fujioka Research Institute) in Fujioka, Gunma Prefecture, the Mikasa Research Institute in Mikasa, Hokkaido, and the Maebashi Research Institute in Maebashi, Gunma Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,002 million.
entries.4f8a0b7596779497: This service uses technology that produces target proteins and antibodies in the cocoons of genetically modified silkworms, and provides contract protein production, sales of reagent raw materials, and manufacturing and sales of human-type collagen. It sells products such as laminin 511-E8 (iMatrix-511 silk), a cell culture scaffold material for iPS cells and other cells. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥102 million.
entries.6aa4923c3d66a38f: This service sells antibody-based research reagents (such as ELISA measurement kits and antibodies), provides reagent-related contract services such as antibody production and purification, licenses pharmaceutical seeds, and manufactures and sells in vitro diagnostic drugs and their raw materials. This is the core of the business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥867 million.
entries.7796a4f06653ec3e: A company that provides antibody-based research reagents, in vitro diagnostic pharmaceuticals, and testing services, and also produces proteins using genetically modified silkworms.
entries.906d22df191bea1b: This service provides research testing centered on "LipoSEARCH®," which performs detailed profiling of blood lipoproteins, and contract measurement through the "IBL Analysis Center," a registered hygiene testing laboratory. It also provides "LipoTEST," a testing service for lipid metabolism-related diseases in companion animals (pets). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31 million.
